limitations.detail: Full Ready including cross-round tokens, earlier deadlines and release selection remains unimplemented; see all12 matrix rows.
True linked Shaman Step fails closed pending a canonical atomic position adapter. Coordinate-only Step does not prove support, Falling, grapple break, passengers, path costs or observer updates.

Only recognized totems and registered copies are bridged. Unknown native concentration changes must be reconciled externally; validation rejection is not cleanup/rollback. General dispel/suppression/body-end behavior and durations are not supplied.
CFI-02 enforces one live adapter on one actually shared ConcentrationLedger only. It neither unifies different falsely canonical ledgers nor serializes/reconstructs ownership and receipt state.
Actual next-attack/save source adapters and one-use roll consumption are absent; Shield supplies AC only. Preserve the printed variants.
Original nonteleport Step path, terrain payment and opportunity consequences remain unimplemented, not forbidden by this review.

Finite typed immunity/resistance/strongest flat reduction is not general vulnerability, redirection, counterspell stack, death prevention/replacement or next-healing source consumption. Unsupported active interceptors still require actual adapters.

Actual Shaman/Mirrorsage acquisition qualifiers are a finite model with conditional learning/training/hero histories. Full class Mirrorbind/capture, Echo strain/payload and other providers remain separate.

Observed source completion, eligibility, geometry/perception/LoE, fit, roll modes and actual regular/extra-turn events remain supplied conditional fixtures. False caller assertions are not authenticated by these models.
No CR2 Undead, owner-level companion CR, source-donor retained CR or opposed Athletics bonus is invented. Existing Companion and Control whole positive-case holds remain.
Private helper RNG and supplied roll inputs are not an extra Fate/DE4 presentation channel. No sixth presentation or hidden roster is approved.
Unmodified class validator uses DI7 locator rooted at C:/Github/DecenniumDescent. Here only in-memory path rebinding allowed isolated replay; no delivered source was rewritten for this relocation.
No blanket335-feat approval, new ordinary spell acceptance, index/registry/runtime flag application, human testing, numerical balance, cosmology,75-domain, whole-game or release closure.
